intro: Lesson 61: Compounds and molecules. To understand how elements join to make compounds and how formulae show them

keywords.def: two or more elements chemically joined
two or more atoms joined together
symbols and numbers showing the atoms in a substance
ending for a compound of two elements, such as sodium chloride

model.title: How many atoms in one molecule of glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆?

questions.q: Name the compound of magnesium and oxygen.
questions.model: Metal first: magnesium. Non-metal second, oxygen, ending changed to -ide: oxide. Magnesium oxide.

questions.q: How many hydrogen atoms in CH₄?
Is O₂ an element or a compound?
For 8 formulae on the sheet (H₂O, CO₂, NaCl, CH₄, O₂, NH₃, CaCO₃, H₂SO₄), name the elements, count the atoms and say element or compound.
questions.a: Correct answers (as on the answer sheet), e.g. NH₃: nitrogen and hydrogen, 4 atoms, compound
questions.model: Teacher does H₂O: 'hydrogen 2, oxygen 1: 3 atoms, compound'.

questions.q: Name: (a) zinc + oxygen, (b) iron + sulfur, (c) potassium + chlorine.
questions.a: Zinc oxide, iron sulfide, potassium chloride

questions.q: How many atoms in 3 molecules of water?
